jobs.description: KelvionBei Kelvion ist es unsere Mission, den industriellen Wandel voranzutreiben, indem wir Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit fördern. Von der Optimierung von Rechenzentren und der Weiterentwicklung der Wasserstoffproduktion bis hin zur Revolutionierung von Kühl- und Klimatechniksystemen – unsere entscheidenden thermischen Lösungen stärken Branchen auf der ganzen Welt. Innerhalb von Kelvion kommt die Kreativität zum Vorschein, weil den Menschen zugehört wird, ihre Beiträge anerkannt und ihre Ideen willkommen geheißen werden. Unser flexibler Ansatz für die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, stellt die Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit der Menschen in den Vordergrund und fördert das Engagement und die Karrieremöglichkeiten. Wir geben engagierten Menschen die Möglichkeit, sich weiterzuentwickeln und ihren eigenen Weg innerhalb des Unternehmens zu gehen. Gemeinsam gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft, indem wir unsere globalen Teams dazu bringen, als „One Kelvion “ zu handeln.- Eine Ihrem Erfahrungs- und Ausbildungsstand angemessene Vergütung nach TV M+E inkl. aller tariflichen Zusatzleistungen- Arbeitszeit im Rahmen eines Gleitzeitmodells und 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr- Eine vom Arbeitgeber unterstützte betriebliche Altersvorsorge- Firmenfitness mit dem EGYM Wellpass- Mitarbeitendenangebote namhafter Hersteller und Händler über Corporate BenefitsEnglish Version (m/f/d)Commercial Employee - Purchasing (m/f/d)KelvionAt Kelvion, our mission is to lead the industrial transformation by championing innovation and sustainability. From optimising data centres and advancing hydrogen production to revolutionizing refrigeration and HVAC systems, our mission-critical thermal solutions empower industries around the globe. United as “One Kelvion,” our global team delivers innovative solutions that drive customer success and support a sustainable future.Kelvion – Together, We Shape the FutureJob DescriptionYour tasks:- You create and send enquiries and purchase orders in the ERP system in accordance with specified guidelines.- You process the associated purchasing-related invoice workflows.- You check order confirmations and goods receipt notifications and contact suppliers in the event of discrepancies.- You handle general correspondence, including complaints, evaluations and other communications in accordance with specified guidelines.- You maintain relevant master data in the ERP system.- You perform system-supported checks and postings of travel expense reports in compliance with legal requirements.- You check, assign accounts to and post incoming invoices without purchase order reference in accordance with applicable organizational instructions and legal requirements.- You handle correspondence related to invoice processing.- You manage export certificates and confirmations of arrival for customer orders in Monzingen, check them for completeness and, if necessary, request missing documents from customers.- You maintain customer and credit master data.Your qualifications:- Completed vocational training in the commercial field- Previous professional experience in procurement/purchasing is desirable- You are characterized by an independent and structured way of working, a strong quality awareness, and an entrepreneurial mindset- You are a team player and enjoy working collaboratively- You are proficient in the common Microsoft Office applications; experience with SAP is an advantage- Good command of German, both written and spoken- Basic knowledge of EnglishAt Kelvion we thrive on collaboration, embracing diversity of thought, and valuing every voice. Within Kelvion creativity shines because people are listened too, their contributions recognized, and their ideas welcomed. Our flexible approach to the way we work, places peoples health and satisfaction as a priority, enhancing engagement and fostering career opportunities. We empower engaged individuals to grow, progress and carve their own paths within the company. Together we shape a brighter future, engaging our global teams to act as “one Kelvion”.- A salary commensurate with your level of experience and training in accordance with TV M+E including all additional benefits under the collective agreement- Working hours within the framework of a flexitime model and 30 days' vacation per year- A company pension scheme supported by the employer- Company fitness with EGYM Wellpass- Offers via corporate benefits

The RTG 2989 “Targeting cellular interfaces in Reperfused Acute Myocardial Infarction (TCI repAMI)” offers outstanding internationally-oriented interdisciplinary scientific research and training opportunities for graduates of experimental life sciences and (bio) medicine with interest in basic and translational cardiovascular research.- You find details on the single projects at our website: https://www.uni-due.de/grk2989/ (https://www.uni-due.de/grk2989/) (please indicate up to three preferred projects in the RTG application form)- Work in a stimulating interdisciplinary and internationally-oriented academic environment at the University Hospital Essen and the cooperating Leibniz-Institut für Analytische Wissenschaften – ISAS – e.V., Dortmund- Depending on the positions to be filled, you will be employed at the University of Duisburg-Essen or at ISAS e.V. DortmundIhr Profil:- Talented and enthusiastic candidates with high interest in the research topic of RTG 2989- Strong Diploma/Master degree in Cell or Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Experimental Medicine or related fields- High motivation and commitment for active cross-disciplinary collaboration- Abilities for problem-solving and independent work- Work with laboratory animals may be obligatory (depending on the project)- Fluent in spoken and written English (knowledge of German is not a requirement)Freuen Sie sich auf:- Innovative cross-disciplinary scientific training for PhD and MD students at the interface between cardiovascular research and infection/immunology- Training in transferable academic and soft skills- Funding for active participation in workshops and conferences and international visits to collaboration partners- Regular supervision and mentoring- Excellent career opportunities- Interdisciplinary work with colleagues from other departments- Working with modern equipment and certified quality standards- Family-friendly corporate cultureRahmenbedingungen: Die Eingruppierung richtet sich nach den persönlichen und tariflichen Voraussetzungen., Schwerbehinderte Bewerberinnen / Bewerber und Gleichgestellte i.S. des § 2 Abs. 3 SGB IX werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt., Das UK Essen strebt eine Erhöhung des Frauenanteils in Bereichen an, in denen Frauen unterrepräsentiert sind. Sie werden zur Bewerbung aufgefordert und im Sinne des LGGs bei gleicher Qualifikation vorrangig berücksichtigt., Eine Bescheinigung gemäß §23a Infektionsschutzgesetz (IfSG) über den Impf- und Serostatus bzgl. Masern ist erforderlich.

jobs.occupation: A scholarship program in social work in Germany! (Sozialarbeiter/in / Sozialpädagoge/-pädagogin)
jobs.description: teamZUKUNFT gGmbHteamZUKUNFT gGmbH is a recognized provider of independent youth welfare services in accordance with §75 SGB VIII and has been supporting children, young people and families in challenging life situations for many years. With a wide range of inpatient and outpatient educational support, equestrian education and therapy, and targeted time-out measures, we respond individually to the needs of our clients. Our portfolio is complemented by experiential education programs for children and young people, such as school trips, day programs for schools, and supervised holiday camps. We work flexibly, according to need, and always with the aim of empowering young people and positively supporting their development.Daily BusinessThe teamZUKUNFT gGmbH is offering dedicated students a scholarship program in Germany. This scholarship program is a unique opportunity for you to pursue a fully funded degree in Social Work at IU International University.  As an independent provider of youth welfare, we run residential groups for children and youth in Düsseldorf, Wermelskirchen, Hilden and Angelburg. These residential communities are social-educational. With us you will find a varied and dynamic work environment. - Child and youth welfare - Supporting the independent living of our clients and working with intensive pedagogical group homes - Outpatient support such as social-pedagogical family assistance, educational mentoring and time-out measures- Experiential educational offerings such as school trips and holiday campsDeine Skills- German language level: B2- Entrance requirement (certified, notarized translation in German or English) - National vocational qualification - A structured, self-responsible way of working, as well as a strong communication personality- Willingness to take over work at weekends and flexible working arrangements- High motivation, teamwork, empathy and creativity are our basic requirementsDeine Benefits- Possibility to study at a local university- Payment of tuition fees - Free national public transport ticket and German courses - Monthly salary starting from 500 EUR (possible promotion) - Advanced vocational education- State-Recognized qualification (social worker)- Free communal residence room in Cologne, Düsseldorf and its environsWe look forward to receiving your detailed and compelling application documents. Please submit them via email to jobs@teamzukunft.online (https://mailto:jobs@teamzukunft.online) **.** Should you have any questions, feel free to contact us by phone at +49 221 9681949.Alternatively, you can apply directly below using the button.
